result.topic_en: Statement of Problem II on the vibrations of an elastic lamina free at one end A and pinned at B so it can rotate freely, with the start of its solution using the general vibration equation and the free-end conditions.
result.transcription:
472 DE MOTV VIBRATORIO

ſupra ſpeciem tertiam, quartam, quintam etc. conſtituebant.

Problema II.

XXIV. Si eadem lamina elaſtica in termino A fuerit libera, in altero vero B ita ſtylo defixa, vt circa eum libere verti poſſit; inuenire motum vibratorium, cuius erit capax.

Solutio.

Pro hoc ergo caſu eaedem aequationes locum habent, quas modo ante euoluimus, ſcilicet poſita abſciſſa AX $= x$ et applicata XY $= y$ habebimus
$y = \cos.\theta\theta t\left(A.\cos.\frac{\theta x}{b} + B.\sin.\frac{\theta x}{b} + Ce^{\frac{\theta x}{b}} + De^{-\frac{\theta x}{b}}\right)$
et quia extremitas E vbi $x = 0$, nullas vires ſuſtinet, habebimus vt ante
$A = C + D \quad \text{et} \quad B = C - D$
tum vero etiam pro arcu EY erit ſumma virium elementarium
$\int p\,dx = -Kcc.\frac{\theta^3}{b^3}\cos.\theta\theta t\left(A\sin.\frac{\theta x}{b} - B\cos.\frac{\theta x}{b} + Ce^{\frac{\theta x}{b}} - De^{-\frac{\theta x}{b}}\right)$
et momentum harum virium reſpectu Y
$= +\frac{Kcc.\theta\theta}{bb}\cos.\theta\theta t\left(A\cos.\frac{\theta x}{b} + B\sin.\frac{\theta x}{b} - Ce^{\frac{\theta x}{b}} - De^{-\frac{\theta x}{b}}\right)$
quae formulae ad alterum terminum vsque B extendantur faciendo $x = a$, ac prior quidem cum vi, quam ipſe ſtylus in B ſuſtinet, in aequilibrio exiſtere debet, quare ſi ſumamus ſtylum in puncto B ſuſti-

items.quote: Si eadem lamina elaſtica in termino A fuerit libera, in altero vero B ita ſtylo defixa, vt circa eum libere verti poſſit; inuenire motum vibratorium, cuius erit capax.
items.english: If the same elastic lamina is free at the end A, but at the other end B is fixed by a pin so that it can turn freely about it, to find the vibratory motion of which it will be capable.
